newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares down at close, need inspiration.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares down at close, need inspiration.

text.p: Singapore shares drifted down at Wednesday's close with buyers searching for inspiration to give the market direction, dealers said.
"We've seen a bit of chop and change today with no firm direction and little indication of anything to change that," a dealer at a local brokerage said.
Activity was muted with a thin 123.5 million shares traded to give the day 319 losing issues compared to 61 gainers.
Drops for Cerebos Pacific, Cycle & Carriage and Yeo Hiap Seng shares strongly influenced the 30-stock Straits Times Industrials Index, which closed down 14.71 at 2,098.26.
Interest was seen in Osprey Maritime which ended the day up Singapore $0.12 at S$2.28 after news of its US$750 million takeover of UK-owned Gotaas-Larsen.
DBS Bank foreign stock was also a good gainer, up S$0.50 at S$19.00. Fellow bank OCBC's foreign shares rose S$0.40 to S$18.90.
Profit taking at Creative Technology saw it head down S$2.10 to S$24.80, topping the losers list for the second day.
